instructions: Read each declaration as a rule over adjacent model states. Unmarked expressions refer to the earlier state, prime reads the later state, and before/after read their named states.

responses.reason: `is(before(status), Shipped)`、前後の `payload` の等号、隣接するモデル状態に適用する `transition`
`status = Sent and status' = Sent`、`attempt' >= attempt`、`status' = Sent`
`before(status) = Sent and after(status) = Sent`、`after(attempt) >= before(attempt)`、`after(status) = Sent`
